data.one_liner: Utility to launch a locally installed version of a CLI when a global version is invoked.
data.what_it_does: When a globally installed CLI runs, it checks for a matching package in the current or parent directories. If a different local version is found, it relaunches the CLI using that local version, otherwise it continues with the global one.
use_when: Developing a Dart CLI that may be installed globally and locally
Ensuring the correct version of a CLI runs during development or CI
avoid_when: You only need a single installation path for your CLI
The CLI is not distributed via pub packages
weaknesses: Only supports launch logic, no other features

alternatives.name: io
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general file and process utilities but lacks the specific launch‑version logic of cli_launcher
